# Bolton Park Dentistry

> > Comprehensive dental care in Bolton, Ontario offering restorative, cosmetic, and preventative treatments by experienced dentists Dr. Mindy Gelfand and Dr. Jasman.

Bolton Park Dentistry is a full-service dental practice located at 14 Parr Blvd Unit 5 in Bolton, Ontario. The practice specializes in both general dentistry and specialized treatments including periodontal care, implant restoration, and TMJ therapy, with a focus on patient comfort and modern restorative techniques.

## Key Topics

- Restorative Dentistry
- Cosmetic Dentistry
- Dental Implants
- Root Canal Therapy
- Periodontal Care
- Dental Crowns
- Preventative Care
- Gum Disease Treatment
- Dr. Mindy Gelfand
- Dr. Jasman
- Tooth Restoration
- CDCP Coverage
- Composite Resin
- Porcelain Restorations
- TMJ Therapy

## Core Services

- [Our Services](https://boltonparkdentistry.com/our-services): Complete overview of dental services offered in Bolton

- [Implant Restoration](https://boltonparkdentistry.com/our-services/implant-restoration): Dental implant restoration and tooth replacement in Bolton
- [Non-Surgical Gum Therapy](https://boltonparkdentistry.com/our-services/non-surgical-gum-therapy): Gum disease treatment and periodontal care by Dr. Gelfand

## Restorative & Cosmetic Treatments

- [Dental Crowns and Bridges](https://boltonparkdentistry.com/our-services/crowns): Dental crowns and caps for smile improvement in Bolton
- [Bonded Fillings](https://boltonparkdentistry.com/our-services/bonded-fillings): Tooth-colored composite restorations and cavity treatment in Bolton
- [Amalgam-Free Fillings](https://boltonparkdentistry.com/our-services/amalgam-free): Amalgam-free restorative fillings by Dr. Jasman and Dr. Gelfand
- [Bridges](https://boltonparkdentistry.com/our-services/bridges): Dental bridges for missing teeth treatment in Bolton
- [Porcelain Veneers](https://boltonparkdentistry.com/our-services/porcelain-veneers): Porcelain veneers for smile makeover in Bolton
- [Porcelain Inlays / Onlays](https://boltonparkdentistry.com/our-services/porcelain-inlays-onlays): Custom porcelain inlays and onlays for tooth restoration
- [Teeth Whitening](https://boltonparkdentistry.com/our-services/teeth-whitening): Professional teeth whitening and smile enhancement services

## Specialized Care

- [TMJ (TMD) Therapy](https://boltonparkdentistry.com/our-services/tmj-tmd-therapy): TMJ and temporomandibular dysfunction treatment in Bolton
- [Dental Extractions](https://boltonparkdentistry.com/our-services/extractions): Tooth extraction and restorative dentistry services in Bolton
- [Sedation](https://boltonparkdentistry.com/our-services/sedation): Sedation options including nitrous oxide for anxious patients
- [Headache Pain Prevention](https://boltonparkdentistry.com/our-services/headache-pain-prevention): Stabilization splints for headache and migraine relief
- [Athletic Sports Guards](https://boltonparkdentistry.com/our-services/athletic-sports-guards): Custom athletic mouthguards and teeth protection for sports
